items.headline: Quad Leaders Meet in Manila to Launch New Indo-Pacific Security and Tech Initiatives
items.summary: Leaders from the United States, Australia, India, and Japan gathered in Manila for a Quad summit on November 17, marking their first leader-level meeting in two years. The four nations announced key initiatives, including a joint maritime patrol exercise planned for 2027 alongside expanded partnerships in cybersecurity and undersea cable resilience.

items.headline: NASA's Voyager 1 Becomes First Spacecraft to Reach One Light-Day From Earth
items.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 probe has reached a historic distance of one light-day from Earth, placing it over 16 billion miles away from our planet. This milestone means radio signals now take 24 hours to travel each way, creating a 48-hour round-trip communication delay for mission engineers.

items.headline: World Rugby Bans South Africa Head Coach Rassie Erasmus for Six Matches
items.summary: World Rugby suspended South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus for six international matches after he publicly questioned whether refereeing decisions in a recent match amounted to match-fixing. The immediate sanction prohibits Erasmus from match-day coaching and entering stadiums, starting with South Africa's upcoming test against Ireland.

items.headline: British Singer RAYE Leads 2027 Grammy Nominations With 11 Nods
items.summary: The Recording Academy officially unveiled the nominations for the 69th Annual Grammy Awards, with British singer-songwriter RAYE leading all artists with 11 total nominations. Her album 'This Music May Contain Hope' earned an Album of the Year nod, topping a list dominated by female musicians including Rosalía and Olivia Rodrigo.
